observation.command:
cd /workspace && awk '
NR==63 {
    print "        -- Revoke access on model and route permissions (these tables are created by"
    print "        -- Django migrations and do not exist yet on a fresh install, so only revoke"
    print "        -- when they are present)"
    print "        DO \\$\\$"
    print "        BEGIN"
    next
}
NR==64 {
    print "            IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema='"'"'public'"'"' AND table_name='"'"'model_permission'"'"') THEN"
    print "                REVOKE ALL ON model_permission FROM \"$QGIS_DB_USER\";"
    print "            END IF;"
    next
}
NR==65 {
    print "            IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema='"'"'public'"'"' AND table_name='"'"'route_permission'"'"') THEN"
    print "                REVOKE ALL ON route_permission FROM \"$QGIS_DB_USER\";"
    print "            END IF;"
    print "        END"
    print "        \\$\\$;"
    next
}
{ print }
' deployment/postgres/init.sh > /tmp/init.sh.new && mv /tmp/init.sh.new deployment/postgres/init.sh && sed -n '55,75p' deployment/postgres/init.sh
